summary: 1–3, Brigham Young is commended for his labors and is relieved of future travel abroad.
meta_description: Revelation given through Joseph Smith the Prophet, in the house of Brigham Young, at Nauvoo, Illinois, July 9, 1841. Brigham Young had just returned to his family in Nauvoo from a nearly two-year mission to England.
